evals.prompt: 帮我审查这个 React 项目的代码规范，检查 frontend/src 目录下的所有文件，给出完整的规范检查报告。
evals.expected_output: Markdown report covering all 5 categories (formatting, React standards, security, performance, naming) for React/JSX files in frontend/src
expectations: Report includes the 5 standard categories with Chinese labels
Report checks React function components and hook usage
Report has a summary table with issue counts
Report checks file naming conventions for .jsx files

evals.prompt: 检查 server 目录的 Node.js 代码质量，运行代码规范检查并生成报告，重点关注错误处理和安全问题。

expectations: Report checks async function error handling in server routes
Report checks for security issues (eval, hardcoded secrets) in server code
Report includes framework-specific feedback for Node.js
Report includes a summary with severity breakdown

evals.prompt: 对比两个文件：frontend/src/components/ToDoList.js 和 frontend/src/components/TaskCard.jsx，检查它们是否符合 React 编码规范。

expectations: Report references specific line numbers in each file
